cells.note: Rebuild, raised from 2: three held stories on Liberia's e-GP, unread in the first pass, were read. The national system was launched in February 2025 and takes bids (LBR-002), with 56 entities onboarded (LBR-003), and runs from advertisement to award (LBR-004); its published counts are of vendors and fees, not tenders.
